howItWorks.title: Three steps for farmers, three for buyers
howItWorks.description: SARURA connects farmers and buyers directly. Browsing is free and no middleman sets the price.
howItWorks.farmersDescription: Turn your harvest into a direct conversation with a buyer.
howItWorks.farmerStep1Body: Create a free account, confirm your email and add your district. You can request identity or cooperative verification later.
howItWorks.farmerStep2Body: Add the crop, quantity, price and photos. Listings with an accurate location and a clear price get more replies.
howItWorks.farmerStep3Body: Chat about price and quantity, agree on pickup and payment, then mark the listing sold when it is gone.
howItWorks.buyersDescription: Find supply you can check and negotiate with directly.
howItWorks.buyerStep1Body: Search by crop, district, price and verification level. No account is needed to browse.
howItWorks.buyerStep2Body: Open a listing and chat with the farmer about quantity, price and delivery or pickup.
howItWorks.buyerStep3Body: Confirm what you agreed in the chat, inspect the produce and pay the farmer directly. SARURA does not process payments in version 1.
howItWorks.ctaBody: Farmers can list free during the pilot; buyers can browse and contact farmers without paying SARURA.

about.title: A direct market for Rwandan farmers and buyers
about.description: SARURA is an agricultural marketplace being built in Kigali to shorten the distance between the people who grow food and the people who need it.
about.problemBody: Too much good produce is sold through long chains where the farmer takes the smallest share and the buyer cannot see where the food came from.
about.farmersBody: Finding a reliable buyer often depends on chance, brokers or a long trip to a market. Prices are uncertain and unsold harvest is wasted.
about.buyersBody: Buyers struggle to find consistent supply, compare real prices and check whether a seller is trustworthy.
about.missionBody: Make direct trade between Rwandan farmers and buyers simple, transparent and fair.
about.missionBodyTwo: We do this by publishing clear listings, naming verification levels and keeping first contact inside a recorded conversation, so both sides know what was agreed.
about.stepListBody: A farmer publishes the crop, quantity, price and location.
about.stepDiscoverBody: A buyer searches by crop, district and price, compares options and reads the farmer profile.
about.stepNegotiateBody: Both sides chat about price and quantity, agree, and trade directly.
about.storyBody: SARURA began with a simple observation: farmers and buyers both want the same thing — a fair, reliable deal — but they rarely have a direct way to find each other.
about.storyBodyTwo: The first version focuses on one district at a time, real listings and real conversations. We are building it with farmers, buyers and cooperatives in Rwanda rather than guessing what they need.
about.teamBody: SARURA is built by a small team in Kigali, working with farmers, buyers and cooperative partners. We publish team details and the full founder story before launch.
about.teamBodyTwo: As the pilot grows, this page will list the people behind SARURA and the partners supporting the work.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains what information SARURA collects, why we collect it, who can see it and how you can control it.
privacy.collectBody: When you register we collect your name, email address, phone number and location (province, district and sector). If you are a farmer we also collect your listings, quantities, prices, photos and descriptions. We also store the messages sent through SARURA.
privacy.whyBody: We use this information to run your account, show buyers what is available, let people contact each other, keep the marketplace safe and improve the service.
privacy.whoBody: Your name, district, verification level and listings are public. Your phone number and email address are never shown publicly. SARURA staff can see account details only for support, investigations or security.
privacy.whoBodyTwo: We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.chatsBody: Conversations are stored on SARURA's servers. Only the two people in a conversation can read it; SARURA staff read it only after a report or a security issue. Conversations with no activity for 12 months are removed.
privacy.retentionBody: Account information is kept while your account is active. Messages are kept for 12 months after the last activity and then removed. Archived listings are kept so past agreements remain understandable. Contact messages are kept for up to 12 months after they are handled.
privacy.rightsBody: You can view and edit your profile, or ask us to correct or delete your account by writing to privacy@sarura.rw.
privacy.rightsBodyTwo: When an account is deleted we remove personal details; some records may be kept in an anonymous form where safety or the law requires it.
privacy.securityBody: We use access controls, encrypted connections and hashed passwords. SARURA does not process digital payments in version 1; buyers and farmers pay each other directly.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about your information, write to privacy@sarura.rw or use the Contact Us form. We are based in Kigali, Rwanda.
privacy.legalNote: SARURA follows Rwanda's personal data protection law. This plain-language policy will be reviewed with legal guidance before launch.
privacy.moreBody: Read the platform policies or contact us with a privacy question.

policies.title: SARURA Platform Policies
policies.description: These rules apply to everyone who uses SARURA. They are enforced on the platform and may be updated as the service grows.
policies.honestBody: List only fresh, unprocessed produce you actually have. The crop, quantity, price, location and photos must be accurate and up to date. Update or mark a listing sold when it is no longer available.
policies.honestBodyTwo: Do not list produce that has not been harvested or that belongs to someone else.
policies.contactTitle: No phone numbers or emails in listings
policies.contactBody: Do not put phone numbers or email addresses in crop names or descriptions. Buyers contact you through SARURA chat.
policies.abuseBody: Fraud, fake listings, stolen goods, harassment, spam, attempts to move people off the platform for a scam, and any illegal use of SARURA are not allowed.
policies.reportsBody: You can report a listing, a profile or a conversation. The SARURA team reviews reports, may ask for more information, and may hide a listing or suspend an account while an investigation is open.
policies.ordersBody: Agree the price, quantity, pickup and payment method in the chat before you trade. If an agreement is cancelled, say who cancelled it and why. Repeated cancellations may be reviewed.
policies.accountsBody: Use your real identity, keep one account per person and never share your password. A verification level must be backed by a genuine check.
policies.enforcementTitle: What happens when rules are broken
policies.enforcementBody: Depending on the seriousness, SARURA may issue a warning, remove a listing, suspend an account or close it permanently. Serious fraud or threats may lead to immediate suspension.
policies.contactUsBody: Questions about these policies or a report? Write to us and we will reply.
policies.helpBody: Read how SARURA works or contact us about a policy question.
